packages.name: Core
packages.description: Shared TypeScript types, FoundryError base class, request ID generation/validation, standard API response envelopes, and secret-safe environment variable parsers.

playground.title: Request IDs, envelopes & env parsing
playground.description: Resolve an incoming x-request-id (or generate a safe one), build a paginated response envelope, and parse environment variables without leaking raw values.

inputs.label: Incoming x-request-id header
inputs.help: Try an unsafe value like 'abc<script>' to see it rejected and replaced.

cli.sourceAddReason: Zero-dependency foundational module safe to vendor directly into application source.

exportedApis.name: FoundryError
exportedApis.description: Base operational error with code, statusCode, category, expose flag, and safe JSON serialization.

exportedApis.name: generateRequestId
exportedApis.description: Generates a collision-resistant, URL-safe request correlation ID.

exportedApis.name: extractOrGenerateRequestId
exportedApis.description: Validates incoming x-request-id header against injection characters or generates a fresh ID.

exportedApis.name: ok / created / paginated / fail
exportedApis.signature: ok<T>(data: T, meta?: Partial<ApiMeta>, statusCode?: number): ApiSuccessResponse<T>
exportedApis.description: Standardized JSON response envelope builders with requestId and pagination metadata.

exportedApis.name: parseEnvString / parseEnvInt / parseEnvBoolean / parseEnvEnum
exportedApis.description: Validates environment variables at startup without leaking raw secret values in exception messages.

configSchema.description: Prefix prepended to generated request IDs.
HTTP header inspected for incoming request ID correlation.
Whether to preserve valid incoming request IDs from upstream proxies.

packages.errorBehavior: Throws FoundryError with code ENV_CONFIG_INVALID (HTTP 500, expose: false) when required environment variables are missing or malformed.
securityNotes: Incoming x-request-id headers are validated against /^[a-zA-Z0-9._:-]{6,128}$/ to prevent log injection and header splitting.
Environment parsers never echo rejected raw values in error messages to prevent accidental secret leakage in crash logs.
FoundryError.toJSON() redacts error messages and details when statusCode >= 500 unless expose: true is explicitly set.
limitations: Framework-agnostic by design; does not attach middleware directly (use @backendfoundry/logger or @backendfoundry/errors for HTTP lifecycle hooks).

packages.name: Validation
packages.description: Typed schema validation for request bodies, query strings, and route parameters with built-in fluent validators, external Zod compatibility, and automatic sensitive-field redaction.

playground.title: Validate a signup request body
playground.description: Runs a real v.object() schema (email, password >= 12 chars, integer age >= 18, enum plan, up to 3 tags) against your JSON. Sensitive field messages are redacted automatically.

cli.sourceAddReason: Self-contained schema validator depending only on @backendfoundry/core.

exportedApis.name: v
exportedApis.signature: v.object(...) | v.string() | v.number() | v.boolean() | v.enum() | v.array()
exportedApis.description: Zero-dependency fluent schema builder compatible with safeParse() and parse().

exportedApis.name: validateBody / validateQuery / validateParams
exportedApis.signature: validateBody<T>(schema: SchemaLike<T>, body: unknown, requestId?: string): T
exportedApis.description: Validates untrusted request input against any BackendFoundry or Zod schema.

exportedApis.name: expressValidate / fastifyValidate
exportedApis.description: Framework middleware and preHandler hooks that populate req.validated and return 400 on failure.

exportedApis.name: ValidationError
exportedApis.description: Structured HTTP 400 error containing field-level issues with redacted sensitive field messages.

configSchema.description: Schema used to validate and transform request.body.
Schema used to validate and coerce request.query parameters.
Schema used to validate route parameters.

packages.errorBehavior: Throws ValidationError (HTTP 400, code: VALIDATION_FAILED) with structured path/code/message issues.
securityNotes: Sensitive fields matching password, secret, token, apiKey, authorization, cvv, or ssn have their error descriptions replaced so rejected secret values are never echoed back.
Use .strict() on object schemas to reject unexpected prototype-pollution or mass-assignment properties.
limitations: Does not parse raw multipart/form-data streams; pair with a body parser with strict byte-size limits before validation.

packages.name: Rate Limit
packages.description: Sliding-window and fixed-window rate limiting with standard IETF/X-RateLimit headers, per-route and per-tenant keys, in-memory local store, and atomic Redis Lua adapter.

playground.title: Burst of requests against a limiter
playground.description: Fires N requests at a fixed interval against createRateLimiter() using a simulated clock, and shows which are allowed (200) and which are blocked (429) with Retry-After.

cli.sourceAddReason: Vendors rate-limit.ts together with its core.ts and errors.ts dependencies.

exportedApis.name: createRateLimiter
exportedApis.description: Creates a rate limiter instance with check(), consumeOrThrow(), and reset().

exportedApis.name: MemoryRateLimitStore
exportedApis.description: Single-process in-memory sliding or fixed window counter store.

exportedApis.name: RedisRateLimitStore
exportedApis.description: Distributed atomic rate-limit store using a Redis Lua script.

exportedApis.name: expressRateLimit / fastifyRateLimit
exportedApis.description: Framework middlewares that attach standard rate-limit headers and reject excess traffic with HTTP 429.

configSchema.description: Maximum allowed requests within windowMs.
Time window duration in milliseconds (>= 50ms).
Counting strategy for in-memory rate limiting.
Storage backend (MemoryRateLimitStore for local/single-process, RedisRateLimitStore for multi-instance).
Whether to allow traffic if the backing Redis store is temporarily unreachable.

packages.errorBehavior: consumeOrThrow() and framework middlewares throw RateLimitExceededError (HTTP 429, code: RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED) with Retry-After header.
securityNotes: When behind a reverse proxy (Cloudflare, ALB, Nginx), configure your framework's trust proxy setting before relying on x-forwarded-for, or spoofed headers can bypass IP limits.
In-memory counters are strictly process-local and are NOT shared across cluster workers or horizontal container replicas.
limitations: MemoryRateLimitStore resets on process restart and does not synchronize across multiple Node.js instances.
RedisRateLimitStore requires a Redis client supporting eval() for atomic INCRBY + PEXPIRE execution.

packages.name: Retry
packages.description: Explicit retry policies with exponential backoff, full/equal jitter, retry predicates, per-attempt timeouts, AbortSignal cancellation, and attempt telemetry.

playground.title: Retry with simulated failures
playground.description: Wraps an operation that fails a configurable number of times. The real createRetry() computes exponential backoff with jitter; delays are simulated so the timeline renders instantly.

inputs.label: Simulated upstream status
inputs.help: 4xx errors (except 408/429) are not retried by defaultShouldRetry.

cli.sourceAddReason: Self-contained reliability helper suitable for direct source vendoring or npm installation.

exportedApis.name: createRetry
exportedApis.description: Creates a reusable retry runner with .executeWithMetadata() and direct function invocation.

exportedApis.name: computeBackoffDelay
exportedApis.description: Calculates exponential backoff with none, full, or equal jitter.

exportedApis.name: RetryExhaustedError
exportedApis.description: Thrown when all configured retry attempts fail.

exportedApis.name: RetryAbortedError
exportedApis.description: Thrown immediately when an AbortSignal cancels an in-flight attempt or backoff sleep.

configSchema.description: Maximum total execution attempts (1 to 20).
Base backoff delay in milliseconds before the first retry.
Upper ceiling for exponential backoff delay in milliseconds.
Exponential multiplier applied after each failed attempt.
Randomization strategy to prevent thundering-herd retry waves.
Optional per-attempt execution timeout in milliseconds.

packages.errorBehavior: Throws RetryExhaustedError (HTTP 502) after exhausting maxAttempts, or rethrows non-retryable 4xx errors on first attempt.
securityNotes: Never blindly retry non-idempotent mutations (such as charging a credit card or sending an email) unless paired with an upstream Idempotency-Key.
Always use 'equal' or 'full' jitter in production to avoid synchronized retry storms against recovering downstream services.
limitations: In-process timer-based retries do not survive process crashes; use a persistent job queue for long-horizon background retries.

packages.name: Circuit Breaker
packages.description: Deterministic CLOSED / OPEN / HALF_OPEN state machine that fast-fails degraded dependencies, limits concurrent recovery probes, and emits state-change telemetry.

playground.title: Circuit breaker state machine
playground.description: Drive createCircuitBreaker() with a sequence of calls. Use ok / fail for calls and wait:<ms> to advance the simulated clock. Watch CLOSED -> OPEN -> HALF_OPEN -> CLOSED transitions.

inputs.label: Call sequence
inputs.default: ok fail fail fail ok ok wait:5000 ok fail wait:5000 ok ok ok

cli.sourceAddReason: Self-contained state machine with zero external dependencies beyond @backendfoundry/core.

exportedApis.name: createCircuitBreaker
exportedApis.description: Creates a circuit breaker instance with execute(), getStats(), and reset().

exportedApis.name: CircuitOpenError
exportedApis.description: Thrown immediately (HTTP 503) when execute() is called while the circuit is OPEN or probe capacity is full.

configSchema.description: Identifier included in logs, metrics, and CircuitOpenError.
Consecutive failures required to trip from CLOSED to OPEN.
Consecutive successful probes in HALF_OPEN required to close the circuit.
Cooldown duration in OPEN state before transitioning to HALF_OPEN.
Maximum concurrent in-flight probe calls permitted while HALF_OPEN.

packages.errorBehavior: Throws CircuitOpenError (HTTP 503, code: CIRCUIT_OPEN) when OPEN or when HALF_OPEN probe slots are saturated.
securityNotes: Configure isFailure() so client-side 400/404 errors do not trip the circuit breaker—otherwise an attacker sending invalid IDs could intentionally trip the circuit for all users.
limitations: State is process-local per Node.js instance, which is typically desirable for fast zero-network-hop shedding but means each replica trips independently.

packages.name: Cache
packages.description: Explicitly scoped key-value caching with TTL management, in-memory and Redis adapters, safe JSON serialization boundaries, prefix invalidation, and stampede-coalesced getOrSet().

playground.title: Cache hits, misses & TTL expiry
playground.description: Runs getOrSet() for each key in the sequence against createCache() with a simulated clock. The loader only runs on a miss. Use wait:<ms> to let entries expire and del:<key> to invalidate.

inputs.label: Operations
inputs.default: user:1 user:2 user:1 user:1 wait:2500 user:1 del:user:2 user:2

cli.sourceAddReason: Vendors cache.ts together with core.ts. The Redis adapter is included but optional.

exportedApis.name: createCache
exportedApis.description: Creates a scoped cache instance supporting get, set, delete, invalidatePrefix, and getOrSet.

exportedApis.name: MemoryCacheStore
exportedApis.description: Bounded in-memory cache store with lazy and active TTL eviction.

exportedApis.name: RedisCacheStore
exportedApis.description: Redis adapter using PX millisecond expiration.

configSchema.description: Top-level key prefix isolating this service's keys.
Default time-to-live in milliseconds when not specified per call.
Forces callers to pass an explicit scope (e.g. 'tenant:acme' or 'public') on every operation.

packages.errorBehavior: Throws CACHE_SCOPE_REQUIRED (HTTP 400) if requireExplicitScope is true and scope is omitted; corrupt stored JSON is evicted and treated as a cache miss.
securityNotes: Enable requireExplicitScope: true in multi-tenant applications so developers cannot accidentally cache tenant-specific data under a global key.
Never cache raw authentication tokens or session secrets in unencrypted shared caches.
limitations: In-flight stampede coalescing in getOrSet() coalesces concurrent misses within the same Node.js process.

packages.name: Idempotency
packages.description: Atomic idempotency key locking, canonical SHA-256 request payload fingerprinting, stored response replay, and concurrent conflict protection.

playground.title: Duplicate request detection
playground.description: Sends each request through createIdempotencyGuard().execute(). Repeated keys with the same payload are replayed without re-running the handler; the same key with a different payload is rejected (422).

packages.runtimeRequirements: Node.js >= 18.18.0, atomic key store for multi-instance deployment

cli.sourceAddReason: Vendors idempotency.ts together with core.ts and errors.ts.

exportedApis.name: createIdempotencyGuard
exportedApis.description: Creates an idempotency guard that locks keys, verifies SHA-256 fingerprints, and replays completed responses.

exportedApis.name: computeRequestFingerprint
exportedApis.signature: computeRequestFingerprint({ method, path, body, scope }): string
exportedApis.description: Generates a deterministic SHA-256 fingerprint over method, path, and canonicalized JSON body.

exportedApis.name: IdempotencyPayloadMismatchError
exportedApis.description: HTTP 422 error thrown when a client reuses an Idempotency-Key with modified parameters.

exportedApis.name: IdempotencyInProgressError
exportedApis.description: HTTP 409 error thrown when a duplicate request arrives while the original execution is still in flight.

configSchema.description: Retention window (default 24 hours) for completed idempotency records.
In-progress lock lease duration before an abandoned lock expires.
HTTP header name used to extract the idempotency token.

packages.errorBehavior: Throws IdempotencyInProgressError (409) for concurrent duplicates and IdempotencyPayloadMismatchError (422) for altered payloads.
securityNotes: Always scope idempotency keys by authenticated tenant or user ID (scope: `tenant:${tenantId}`) so one tenant cannot probe or replay another tenant's responses.
limitations: MemoryIdempotencyStore is single-process only; use a distributed store with atomic compare-and-set (Redis SET NX PX or PostgreSQL unique constraint) in multi-replica deployments.

packages.name: Webhooks
packages.description: HMAC-SHA256 webhook signing, constant-time signature verification, timestamp replay-window enforcement, zero-downtime secret rotation, and event deduplication.

playground.title: Sign & verify a webhook
playground.description: Signs the payload with HMAC-SHA256 (t=<ts>,v1=<sig>) and verifies it with timestamp tolerance and secret rotation. Toggle tampering or clock skew to see verification fail.

cli.sourceAddReason: Uses built-in node:crypto and @backendfoundry/core; supports both npm install and source vendoring.

exportedApis.name: signWebhookPayload
exportedApis.description: Computes `t=<epoch>,v1=<hmac_sha256>` signature header over `<timestamp>.<rawBody>`.

exportedApis.name: verifyWebhookSignature
exportedApis.description: Verifies HMAC signature using crypto.timingSafeEqual and checks replay window tolerance.

exportedApis.name: verifyWebhookOrThrow
exportedApis.description: Throws WebhookVerificationError (HTTP 401) if signature or timestamp is invalid.

exportedApis.name: MemoryWebhookDeduplicator
exportedApis.description: Tracks processed webhook event IDs to prevent duplicate side effects during at-least-once delivery.

configSchema.description: Signing secret or array of active secrets during key rotation (>= 8 chars).
Maximum allowed clock skew / replay window in seconds (default 5 minutes).
Signature version tag in the header.

packages.errorBehavior: verifyWebhookOrThrow() throws WebhookVerificationError (HTTP 401, code: WEBHOOK_VERIFICATION_FAILED) with reason metadata.
securityNotes: Always verify signatures against the exact raw request body string or Buffer before JSON parsing and re-serialization, as whitespace changes alter the HMAC.
Uses crypto.timingSafeEqual on equal-length hex digests to prevent timing side-channel attacks.
Never log signing secrets in debug or error logs.
limitations: Provider-specific formats (e.g. GitHub X-Hub-Signature-256 or Slack v0=) use different header layouts; @backendfoundry/webhooks implements the timestamped `t=...,v1=...` envelope.

packages.name: Health
packages.description: Kubernetes/cloud-ready liveness and readiness checks with custom dependency probes, strict per-probe timeouts, and credential-sanitized JSON output.

playground.title: Readiness probes
playground.description: Registers probes with simulated latency and failures, then runs checkReadiness(). Critical failures yield 503/unhealthy, non-critical ones yield degraded, slow probes time out. Credentials in messages are scrubbed.

cli.sourceAddReason: Lightweight probe runner suitable for direct source addition or package installation.

exportedApis.name: createHealthRegistry
exportedApis.description: Creates a probe registry with registerProbe(), checkLiveness(), checkReadiness(), and expressHandlers().

configSchema.description: Application release version reported in health responses.
Default timeout in milliseconds per dependency probe.
Whether to include sanitized probe error messages in public readiness responses.

packages.errorBehavior: Never throws from checkReadiness(); returns HTTP 503 with status 'unhealthy' when any critical probe fails or times out, and HTTP 200 'degraded' when only non-critical probes fail.
securityNotes: By default exposeErrorMessages is false so public /health/ready endpoints never reveal internal database hostnames, ports, or driver exceptions.
Even when exposeErrorMessages is enabled, scrubSensitiveMessage() strips connection strings and bearer tokens.
limitations: Avoid running expensive full-table queries in readiness probes, as orchestrators poll readiness every few seconds.

playground.title: Safe error serialization
playground.description: Throws the selected error and runs it through toSafeErrorResponse(). 5xx internals are hidden, credentials are scrubbed, and 429s get a Retry-After header.

cli.sourceAddReason: Core error catalog depending only on @backendfoundry/core.

exportedApis.name: toSafeErrorResponse

exportedApis.name: createExpressErrorHandler / createFastifyErrorHandler

inputs.label: Log calls (JSON array)

exportedApis.name: runWithRequestContext

exportedApis.name: redactSensitiveObject

exportedApis.name: expressRequestLogger
exportedApis.description: Express middleware that initializes request context and logs HTTP method, path, status, outcome, and durationMs.

Minimum log severity threshold.
Additional field names to redact alongside default password/token/secret keys.

packages.name: AI

inputs.label: Prompt
inputs.default: Summarize: checkout latency spiked to 4s after the 14:02 deploy.

cli.sourceAddReason: Vendors ai.ts with validation.ts, retry.ts, errors.ts and core.ts.

exportedApis.name: createAiClient
exportedApis.description: Creates a resilient AI client supporting generateText() and schema-validated generateObject().

exportedApis.name: MockAiProvider
exportedApis.description: Deterministic mock provider for local development, CI tests, and playground fault injection.

exportedApis.name: OpenAiCompatibleProvider
exportedApis.description: Optional HTTP adapter for OpenAI-compatible chat completion APIs.

exportedApis.name: AiProviderError
exportedApis.description: Normalized error across providers (AI_TIMEOUT, AI_RATE_LIMITED, AI_AUTH_ERROR, AI_INVALID_OUTPUT).

configSchema.description: Primary model provider adapter.
Ordered fallback providers invoked when the primary provider exhausts retries.
Retry attempts per provider before failing over.
Timeout in milliseconds per provider attempt.

packages.errorBehavior: Throws AiProviderError; authentication errors (401) skip retries on the misconfigured provider and immediately attempt fallback.
securityNotes: Never hardcode OPENAI_API_KEY or provider secrets in source files; pass keys via server-side environment configuration.
